title: I Have Loved You
old_p1: Malachi was a prophet who lived over 400 years before Jesus was born. A prophet is a man who speaks for Heavenly Father.
Malachi’s people had come home to Jerusalem. But many had stopped thinking about the Lord.
The Lord gave Malachi a message. He said, “I have loved you.” The people asked, “How have You loved us?”
old_p2: The Lord said His name would be great “from the rising of the sun” to its “going down.” That means everywhere the sun shines, all over the world. The Lord was Jesus, speaking for Heavenly Father.
Jesus loves you too, every morning and every night. Tonight, hug yourself tight and feel how much you are loved.
p1: Long before Jesus was born, Heavenly Father’s people came home to Jerusalem. But many had stopped thinking about the Lord.
So the Lord gave Malachi a message to share. It began with four warm words: “I have loved you.”
The people asked, “How have You loved us?” So the Lord reminded them. He had loved their family since long ago, all the way back to Jacob.
p2: The Lord said His name would be great everywhere. From “the rising of the sun” to its “going down,” all would know Him. The Lord who spoke to Malachi was Jesus, speaking for Heavenly Father.
Jesus loves you too, every morning and every night. Tonight, say “I love you” to someone you love, and feel His love too.
